role: Read-only named commodity prices on a cleared global macro year. Does not write back oil_commodity or CPI.

nominal_price_usd.note: Contract nominal price in the contract unit.

real_price_index.note: Real price index; 100 at the opening real level.

nominal_high_usd.note: Brent year high from the oil envelope. Not traded OHLC.

nominal_low_usd.note: Brent year low from the oil envelope. Not traded OHLC.

real_high_index.note: Brent real year high. Same envelope as nominal high.

real_low_index.note: Brent real year low. Same envelope as nominal low.

monthly.note: Brent only. 12 intra-year bars expanded from the annual envelope; each month nests 4 weekly bars. Not traded months or weeks.

nominal_index.note: Kind basket, CPI-inclusive, 100 at open times CPI/100.

invariants: brent year envelope: low <= min(previous close, close) <= max(previous close, close) <= high
brent year envelope leftover range follows annual drift; tight markets widen the range

brent monthly: 12 bars from the annual envelope; month 1 open = annual open; month 12 close = annual close; max high = year high; min low = year low; leftover range is swept by wicks, not by pinning a monthly close

brent weekly: 4 bars nested under each monthly bar; week 1 open = month open; week 4 close = month close; max high = month high; min low = month low; leftover month range is swept by weekly wicks, not by pinning a weekly close
